source_snapshot.procedure: Read NVMe FW Rev, download a supplied image to hard-coded /dev/nvme0n1, activate action 1 slot 2, reset /dev/nvme0 and verify FW Rev changes.
source_snapshot.criteria: Flash succeeds with no error; no target revision or post-flash health criteria.
source_snapshot.script: No Script; Config-Check; 20/20 minutes; code also exists at row 2203 for unrelated USB2/3 Function Check.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL with vendor image/tool and brick warning, but lacks exact target, compatibility, authorization and recovery gates.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; requires controller/namespace binding, signed image, maintenance approval, recovery and post-flash integrity.

old_problem: The source hard-codes volatile namespace/controller paths, activation action and slot without proving physical target, image compatibility, approved target revision, quiesce, stable power or recovery. A changed FW Rev alone cannot prove correct-target health. The shared code also labels an unrelated row-2203 USB case.
disposition_reason: ED-07 requires the approved Flash coverage to remain and to verify pre/post versions, while authorization is an independent safety gate. ED-02 isolates this M.2 variant from row 2203. Exact model/serial/PCI identity, signed image, slot/action semantics, target revision, quiesce and vendor recovery are runtime package inputs, so the review can be resolved to a parameterized controlled flash without inventing OEM data.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2041, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, duplicate-code identities and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next row Functionality 2042 / Wistron-HW-00485-V002 / 1632a101996d60b0 was directly read from XLSX.
Namespace numbers are not stable physical identity; controller, namespace, model, serial and PCI path must cross-match immediately before any write or reset.
NVMe firmware download and commit/activation are state-changing; action 1, slot 2 and reset behavior are accepted only when the vendor compatibility/slot matrix explicitly approves them.
PASS requires the approved expected revision and post-activation namespace/SMART/error-log integrity, not merely command success or any version change.
Row 2203 USB2/3 Function Check remains an independent Source Key/Variant and shares no evidence or verdict.
No nvme command, image read/write, firmware download/commit/activation, controller reset, I/O, power action or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: Authorized identity-bound M.2 NVMe firmware flash and integrity verification
test_case.purpose: Flash the explicitly approved M.2 NVMe controller with the vendor-approved image, verify the exact pre/post firmware revisions and activation slot, then prove the same physical device and all approved namespaces remain healthy without reducing the original flash coverage.
required_package: Exact row-2041 variant and target model/serial/PCI path/controller/namespace mapping; row-2203 exclusion
Vendor-approved immutable firmware image/checksum, release notes, compatibility matrix and expected revision
Approved nvme-cli/vendor tool, download/commit action and slot/reset semantics
Explicit one-run flash/reset authorization, maintenance window, stable power, quiesce/unmount/boot-disk exclusion evidence
Backup/replacement media plus vendor recovery/RMA procedure and human verdict owner
test_case.test_command: TWO-GATE STATE-CHANGING TEST. Gate 1 read-only: prove model/serial/PCI/controller/namespace identity, boot/mount/RAID/I/O ownership, current revision/slot, SMART, namespace and error-log baseline; verify image checksum, compatibility, expected revision, action/slot and recovery. Gate 2 requires explicit authorization naming that physical drive, image checksum, download, commit/activation and controller reset. Only then perform the approved vendor sequence against the verified controller/namespace, capture every command/exit, activate exactly as approved, reset only if vendor-required, re-enumerate by immutable identity, and collect post-revision/slot/SMART/namespaces/error logs. Never substitute `/dev/nvme0*` by position, retry automatically or touch row-2203 USB coverage.
test_case.expected_result: The authorized image downloads and activates on the exact approved M.2 only; pre-revision changes to the specified post-revision in the approved slot, the same serial/PCI identity returns, all expected namespaces remain present and unmounted/healthy, and SMART/error logs show no new failure or data-integrity regression.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires explicit authorization, exact immutable identity, approved checksum/compatibility/action/slot, complete pre/post revision and health evidence and no new errors. FAIL on wrong/ambiguous/in-use/boot target, checksum or compatibility mismatch, unexpected revision/slot, command error, disappearance, namespace/SMART/error-log regression or unauthorized reset. Missing package/authorization/recovery is NOT READY; no retry.
safety_gate: No write until target identity, boot/mount/RAID/I/O exclusion, image checksum/compatibility and recovery are independently approved.
Flash/download/commit/activation/reset each require the explicit authorization scope; stable power and maintenance isolation are mandatory.
Stop on any mismatch, warning, timeout, disappearance, unexpected revision/slot or health regression; never auto-retry.
Preserve full pre/failure/post evidence; do not clear logs or attempt rollback unless a separately approved vendor recovery authorizes it.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant/hash and row-2203 variant-isolation record
Authorization with target model/serial/PCI identity, image checksum, expected revision, action/slot/reset scope and expiry
Pre-flash controller/namespace mapping, boot/mount/RAID/I/O exclusion, revision/slot, SMART/error logs and image validation
Complete download/commit/activation/reset transcripts with timestamps/exits and operator identity
Post-flash immutable identity, expected revision/slot, namespace/SMART/error-log comparison and reboot/OS availability if required
No-retry/no-log-clear audit, recovery readiness and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: At any mismatch or failure, stop immediately, preserve controller/image/command/SMART/error/SEL evidence and keep the device isolated. Do not repeat download, commit, reset, power-cycle or rollback automatically. Invoke only the separately approved vendor recovery/RMA path using the same immutable identity; restore service or data only after owner acceptance.

source_conflict.reason: Exact Source Key/Variant isolation plus immutable target/image/action/slot authorization resolves the hard-coded path and shared-code ambiguity without deleting Flash coverage.

blocked.reason: A complete gated flash method and recovery boundary exist; target, image, authorization and maintenance details are supplyable runtime Project Configuration.
